messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — I found three broken anchor links in private/install-playbook.md after some headings were renamed. I opened a tiny PR to fix anchors and add a minimal preflight network check snippet for air-gapped installs. pinging @sam for KMS/HSM wording sanity check.

sam: Thanks — can you paste the snippet here so I can review the ports and behavior for HSM and KMS connectivity?

maria: Sure, initial snippet I proposed:```bash
# minimal conn check for isolated installs
# returns nonzero on failure
curl --max-time 5 http://169.254.169.254 || echo "metadata unreachable"
if command -v nc >/dev/null; then
  nc -zv kms.internal 2090 || exit 1
else
  # fallback using bash /dev/tcp (not available on all shells)
  (echo > /dev/tcp/kms.internal/2090) && echo "KMS reachable" || exit 1
fi
```

ops_jay: For Windows agents we should include a PowerShell equivalent: `Test-NetConnection -ComputerName kms.internal -Port 2090`. Also add a warning about minimal images not shipping `nc` and ensure the doc recommends installing busybox/netcat in the bootstrap image.

kevin: I reviewed PR #7890 (looks like the right change). A couple of small nits: change phrasing from "air-gapped" to "air-gapped / isolated" in the intro paragraph for consistency, and add an explicit PKCS#11 path example for HSMs under the HSM section.

maria: Added an HSM PKCS#11 example and updated the wording. Also linked to a short helper script at https://git.redwood/infra/conn-check.sh and added an inline note about MTU issues for gRPC during large model downloads. :thumbsup:

docs-bot: Deploy preview for docs PR #7890 is up: https://deploy.preview/7890 :eyes: (preview expires in 24h)

elena_infra: Quick infra note — that fallback `(echo > /dev/tcp/host/port)` uses bash-specific redirection and will fail in `dash`. Suggest using this guarded fallback so minimal images don't break:
```bash
if command -v nc >/dev/null; then
  nc -zv "$HOST" $PORT
elif [ -e /dev/tcp ]; then
  (echo > /dev/tcp/"$HOST"/$PORT) && echo "open" || echo "closed"
else
  echo "no conn-check tool available, install busybox or netcat"
  exit 2
fi
```

maria: Good catch, I pushed the guarded fallback and added the PowerShell snippet for Windows. I also updated the installer preflight section to call out the required ports for KMS (2090) and HSM (3300) and linked to the priv-vpc egress notes. Requesting review from @kevin and @ops_jay again.

kevin: LGTM apart from one last suggestion: include a short example of iptables/nftables rules to allow ephemeral egress to KMS in private clusters. Something like:
```bash
# allow outbound to kms.internal:2090
iptables -A OUTPUT -d 10.10.40.8 -p tcp --dport 2090 -m conntrack --ctstate NEW,ESTABLISHED -j ACCEPT
iptables -A INPUT  -p tcp --sport 2090 -m conntrack --ctstate ESTABLISHED -j ACCEPT
```

ops_jay: Approved, CI checks are green in preview. I'll merge once the small iptables example is added. :shipit:

maria: Added iptables example and a short note recommending nftables equivalents. Merging now. Thanks everyone — I'll follow up next week with a short HA HSM cluster checklist and a Windows bootstrapping note for the installer.

kevin: Thanks — nice quick turnaround.

ops_jay: Merged. Will watch for any support tickets after deploy. :eyes:
